notes: Fixed: "Sync Channels" failing with "Maximum number of webhooks reached (15)" - old bot webhooks are now cleaned up.
Improved: Farm Tickets opens the game on all instances at the same time.
Changed: Trade from Gold Cards disabled.
Improved: "Sync Channels" errors now show the real cause instead of "check the bot's permissions".
Added: /transfers - your card transfer history with card photo, date, account and friend ID.
Added: transfer audit before Start - blocks accounts with no copies left and suggests others.
Added: "Transfer completed" summary after every successful Main Trade.
Improved: Main now finalizes in parallel with the donor's swipe (~30 s faster).
Improved: trade photos upload in the background instead of pausing the trade.
Improved: donor taps View and Trade much faster.
Fixed: wishlist heart was missed at some scroll positions.
Fixed: lost taps (search, Favorites, profile, confirm) are now retried.
Fixed: donor no longer offers a random card if the requested one was not marked.
Fixed: "Got it!" screen not detected - missing final trade photos.
Changed: Friend Trade disabled; Main Trade is the trade mode (also from Gold Cards).
Fixed: ~100 Deluxe Pack reprints now show under their original expansion.
Added: /card name search can show all results, not only the first 25.
Improved: Farm Tickets arranges windows, sets speed to x3 and types the ID faster.
Changed: all bot messages in Discord are now in English.
Improved: Main Trade image detection rebuilt Kevin-style (small icons, fixed zones, no text).
Fixed: ~25 broken detections that failed or matched the wrong screen.
Improved: donor now boots and sends the friend request in parallel with Main.
Improved: pending-offer check runs right after Main boots, in parallel with the donor.
Fixed: pending-offer check could tap into the Shop instead of Community.
Improved: optional popups are checked on the fly instead of waited for (up to ~30 s saved per trade).
Added: auto-close for "game closed", "trade cancelled" and "Player's Featured" screens.
Added: zoomed card is closed automatically before confirming.
Fixed: speed is no longer lowered twice with a blind tap.
Removed: text-based detections that only worked in English.
Added: /farmtickets - farm Shop Tickets by liking Community Showcases with several instances at once.
Added: Pokedex "View All" button, PDF export and a loading notice.
Improved: cards sorted by rarity (high to low) and grouped by element everywhere.
Fixed: Deluxe Pack cards now show in both their original expansion and Deluxe.
Fixed: duplicate results in /card, /wishlist and /goldcards autocomplete.
Improved: Heartbeat auto-close alert is deleted from the channel after 10 minutes (DM kept).

Fixed a real bug that made Main Trade always redo everything: the "is there a trade already pending?" check was given less time than it needs to even reach the screen it inspects, so it was killed before answering and always reported "nothing pending". Retrying a half-finished trade now skips straight to the remaining steps instead of starting from scratch.

Fixed a real bug behind most "it did not click" reports: the game ignores taps while it is busy confirming with its server, and the scripts tapped once and moved on believing it worked. Every confirmation button now retries until the next screen actually appears, and reports honestly if it never does.

Fixed a real bug that left both accounts waiting on each other until the trade expired: the donor never tapped Refresh while on "Waiting for a Response", and the game does not push that update on its own.
Fixed a real bug: the swipe-to-send step could never recognize its own screen, because the tolerance was left over from the previous needle - so that step failed every time, regardless of timing.
Fixed a real bug: two different trade screens share the same background artwork, and the script could not tell them apart at any tolerance - it acted on the wrong one and then failed further down.

Fixed: marking a wishlist card as favorite no longer needs the emulator window in front and no longer steals your mouse - it now goes through ADB like every other action, with the old method kept as a fallback.
Fixed a real bug that looked like the game closing by itself: a swipe started too close to the top edge and pulled down Android notification shade over the game.
Fixed a real bug: Heartbeat crashed on every single cycle (two helper functions were missing), so it showed as running but never reported anything.
Fixed: instances wasted around 80 seconds of dead waiting before any work started - they now boot in parallel with a single settling pause.
New: all four Main Trade scripts now write their own step-by-step debug log, so a failure points at the exact step instead of needing several runs to narrow down.

Fixed a real bug affecting non-English accounts: Info Accounts could report a wrong Shinedust (or Poke Gold/tickets/hourglass) count. First found as extra leading digits (a real 31,470 read as 1,131,470) caused by the OCR crop's label text getting misread as digits in that language and glued onto the number. The first fix broke a second case live testing right after: some languages use a space as the thousands separator (31 470, not 31,470), which the first fix's "last digit group" logic split apart, losing the leading digits (470 instead of 31470). Now recognizes a properly-grouped number (space or comma every 3 digits) as one unit, so it survives intact either way.

Fixed several more spots with the same bug as below: the /webhook command's autocomplete, its "Configured Webhooks" list, its per-webhook edit panel, and the check that stops /setup from running in a channel that already has another command - all looked up server config by the wrong ID and silently found nothing for anyone but one specific setup, even though everything had been configured correctly.

Fixed a real bug affecting every new user: injecting an account (Info Accounts, Shinedust, Add Friend, Main.ahk lookup) always failed with "faltan_archivos" even with Main Path correctly configured. The path was being saved correctly, but looked up using the wrong ID everywhere it mattered - so a brand-new setup never found it and silently fell back to a hardcoded default that only exists on one specific PC. Now looks it up the same way it's saved, so it actually finds your own configured path.

Fixed a real bug: the app only looked for AutoHotkey on drive C:, so anyone with it installed on a different drive (common if your whole setup lives there, like D:) got "faltan_archivos" on every injection (Info Accounts, Shinedust, Add Friend) with no real clue why. Now checks every drive, same as it already did for the emulator manager.

Fixed a real bug affecting anyone with more than one MuMu Player installation (e.g. a regular MuMuPlayer plus MuMuPlayerGlobal): the app always connected to whichever installation it found first, even if it had none of your real instances - so Heartbeat/auto-recovery silently talked to the wrong, empty MuMu the whole time. Now checks every installation found and picks the one that actually has your instances.

Fixed a real bug reported live: instances could get stuck restarting themselves over and over in a tight loop instead of just once. A single flaky read from the emulator manager was enough to reset the freeze tracker early, so the very next check re-triggered a full restart from scratch even though the instance genuinely hadn't recovered yet. Now only clears once the instance has actually made real progress again.

Fixed a real bug in the new Heartbeat summary: an old instance you no longer use (but whose log file is still sitting on disk from a past setup) kept showing up in the instance list with its old, stale data. Now only counts instances whose log was actually written to in the last 24 hours.

Fixed a real bug affecting anyone with more than one MuMu Player installation (e.g. a regular MuMuPlayer plus MuMuPlayerGlobal): the app always connected to whichever installation it found first, even if it had none of your real instances - so Heartbeat/auto-recovery silently talked to the wrong, empty MuMu the whole time. Now checks every installation found and picks the one that actually has your instances.

Fixed a real bug: the new Heartbeat summary's combined PPM showed 0.00 once every instance had stopped for the day, even with real packs already claimed in that session - it only counted instances currently online at that exact moment. Now averages over the whole session's elapsed time, so it stays accurate after everything's closed too.

Fixed a real bug affecting the new panel-independent Heartbeat summary: it listed every instance slot MuMuManager has ever known about on that PC (old/test instances included) as Offline, instead of only the ones actually in use - inflating the instance count for anyone with leftover unused slots. Now only counts instances with a real, active farming log.

New: Heartbeat monitoring now works even if the automation panel (PTCGPB.ahk) is never opened - it reads each instance's own local log directly, so frozen or out-of-24h-account instances still get detected, auto-recovered/closed, and reported to Discord either way.

Fixed a real bug: a stuck instance's freeze timer compared the wrong log field and could never actually refresh, so any instance being monitored this new way would eventually get flagged as frozen and restarted even while it was opening packs fine.

Fixed a real bug reported by several users: updating could flash several black console windows in a row (looked like a virus to some) - a handful of internal commands used during the update/startup process (hiding the engine file, extracting new assets, the "already running" popup, closing the tray icon) never told Windows to keep their console hidden. All of them now stay fully invisible like they were meant to.

Fixed a real bug affecting wishlist matching: S4T's live card lookup only checked the account's XML file directly inside the configured "XML Accounts Path" folder, not any subfolder inside it - so an account whose XML lives in a subfolder (confirmed live: a real wishlist card, "Irida", never migrated to the wishlist channel) silently failed to match, even though the file genuinely existed and Extract XML could already find it fine. Now searches subfolders too, same as Extract XML always did.
Fixed: the "2 Star Shiny" rarity showed as just "Shiny" everywhere (inconsistent with "1 Star Shiny", which already showed its number) - now says "2 Star Shiny" too.

New: All Cards/Gold Cards now show a "Which group do you want to browse?" step first when your catalog has more than one series (Series A/B) - a visual collage of each expansion's real pack art and logo, with a button to switch between groups and a dropdown to jump straight to a specific expansion.

New: the rarity/category screen (All Cards, Wishlist, Gold Cards) is now a visual collage - rounded cards with the real rarity icon, the elemental types found in that rarity, and any Trainer subtypes (Item/Supporter/Tool/Stadium) present, instead of a plain text list.
New: the "Select an element/type" screen inside a rarity category also got the same visual collage treatment instead of a plain text list.

Fixed a real bug: the S4T/Heartbeat On/Off button in /setup could show the wrong color (offline) even while genuinely working, if that PC happened to have PM2 installed for anything else - the status check assumed PM2 was managing the process just because it was present. Now detects the packaged app directly and reads the real status from its own database instead.

Fixed a real bug: a hung AHK script (Windows "Not Responding", not just closed) was never detected as such - heartbeat kept restarting the game underneath it while the frozen script sat there forever, never actually recovering. Now detects a real hang and closes + relaunches that script fresh.

Fixed a real bug: restarting an instance from a frozen state could fail silently if the emulator's own manager returned a transient error right after being restarted - now retries a few times instead of giving up on the first try.

Fixed a real bug found live: if 2+ instances froze around the same time, heartbeat could fire their recoveries in parallel, and several restart commands hitting the emulator manager at once could crash it entirely for every instance, including the ones that were fine. Recoveries are now always run one at a time.

New: the "Reload AHK" button on a failed auto-recovery is now "🔧 Restart Instance" - it turns the instance back on, reopens the game, and reattaches the script all from Discord, instead of only nudging an AHK panel that assumes the instance is already running.

New: heartbeat now also reports (informational only, auto-recovers on its own) when the automation tool's own built-in freeze detection catches and restarts a stuck screen - previously only heartbeat's own detection was visible in Discord.

Fixed a real bug affecting anyone who reconfigured channels/webhooks after updating to 1.5.79 (Sync Channels, or any /setup change): the new per-server config lives in a new database row, but the old per-person one never gets deleted - S4T could keep reading the old, now-broken one instead of the current one, silently failing every send with no visible error ("active" in /setup, but nothing arrives). Now always uses the most recently saved config, no action needed on your end.

Fixed a real bug: turning S4T or Heartbeat Off then On again from /setup could restart the process onto a different port than usual if the old one hadn't been released yet, and nothing that sends it data knows to look anywhere but the normal port - so it looked "on" but silently received nothing. Now retries the normal port for a few seconds before ever considering a different one.

Fixed a real chicken-and-egg bug reported by a real new user: without a token configured yet, the whole program used to shut itself down completely, including the Dashboard/Tutorials page — so a brand-new user had no way to even open the tutorial that explains how to get a token in the first place. Now the Dashboard and Tutorials page start normally with no token configured; only Discord itself stays offline until you save a real token from the Control Panel.

Fixed a real bug affecting any account whose game language isn't English: wishlist matching for S4T alerts compared the on-screen card name (shown in the account's own language) against English reference data, so a real wishlist match (confirmed live: "Irida", a Chinese-language account) was never detected and never posted to the wishlist channel. Now matches by rarity + pull position instead of by name, which works regardless of language.

Fixed a real bug affecting servers with more than one Administrator: channel/webhook setup was tracked per-person instead of per-server, so if two admins each ran Sync Channels, one would silently delete and replace the other's webhooks, causing commands to fail with errors like "Could not send All Cards" and the Control Panel showing the wrong "User". Now shared per-server — IMPORTANT: run Sync Channels once after this update (in /setup) to migrate your existing setup, or commands will show "No channel synced" until you do.

New: Wishlist now shows a visual collage with the real artwork and quantities of your cards instead of a plain text list, and lets you pick a card directly from a dropdown instead of navigating through expansions/categories first.
Disabled: Trade, Friend Trade, Main Trade, Aggressive Trade and Gold Trade buttons while we finish a better version of Main Trade.
Fixed a real bug: after 3 failed auto-update tries, the app kept looping the failure popup forever instead of showing it once.
Disabled: Main Trade and Aggressive Trade, while we finish improving them.
Fixed: title screen not recognized after the game's new visual update.
Fixed: card swipe failing when Speed Mod was active at 3x.
Fixed: heartbeat could go silent forever after one failed recovery attempt.
Fixed: stuck "previous instance" dialogs are now auto-dismissed.
Improved: Main Trade screen checks run much faster than before.
Fixed: /allcards now also finds card images from our shared repo.
Fixed: a real Main Trade bug where the final OK tap didn't register.

Fixed a real bug affecting anyone already stuck from a past failed update (before this fix existed, so nothing was queued to retry): the app now checks on every startup whether it's actually running the version it claims to be, and if a previous update was downloaded but never truly installed, re-queues the swap automatically instead of leaving it broken forever with no visible sign anything was wrong.

Fixed a real bug: if the automatic update's file swap failed (old .exe stayed locked, usually antivirus), the app quietly gave up and stayed on the old version forever, even though it reported "already up to date" - no error, no retry, nothing to click. Now retries the swap automatically on the next 2 restarts, and if it still can't finish after 3 tries, shows a real popup telling you to grab the .exe by hand instead of failing silently.

Improved: Friend Trade button is now blue (matching Main Trade) instead of grey, so it's clearly active - it was working in 1.5.72 too, just easy to mistake for disabled since it looked like the greyed-out Aggressive Trade button next to it.
New: Main Trade now sends a final summary collage with all 3 phases of the trade (Offer/Send/Receive, both sides) plus a thank-you message, in addition to the live step-by-step photos.

Fixed a real bug: the message showing Main sending its own card displayed the wrong card's info (copied from the donor's card instead of showing no misleading data), since Main's actual card is chosen blindly and was never known.
New: added confirmation photos right after each swipe (donor and Main), not just before - proof the card was actually sent, not just attempted.

Fixed a real bug: "Repair Broken Files" (and "Kill Everything") killed the Control Panel itself as a side effect of its own first step (it matches any process named MonitorPokemonPanel.exe - including the one running the button you just clicked), so it silently died right there and never actually got to re-download anything or turn the app back on. Now excludes itself from that step, so the repair genuinely runs to completion.

Fixed a real bug: the new Item icon (Casco Dentado) never actually showed up on any server that already had the old "card_item" icon created (a generic backpack) - changing the source image alone doesn't replace an icon Discord already has under that name. Now force-refreshes it once so everyone gets the real one.

Fixed a real bug: the "Sync Channels + re-save Main Path" reminder after an update only showed up if you used Discord's "Update now" button - the Control Panel's "Download Now" and "Repair Broken Files" never showed it. Centralized so it now shows no matter which one you use.
Fixed: "Repair Broken Files" never updated the local version number after replacing everything, so the app could keep thinking it was still on the old version - now refreshes it too.

Fixed a real bug: removing an unused icon from the internal list only stopped creating NEW copies of it - the old one stayed sitting on the server forever, taking up one of the 50 emoji slots and blocking genuinely new icons from being created. Now actively removes a specific list of known-retired icons the next time it builds the icon map.
New: Gold Cards now picks a random wallpaper from the shared image repository each time, like All Cards/Wishlist already did - was stuck on one fixed image before.
New: separate icons for Item, Fossil, and Stadium trainer-card subtypes (Stadium had none before, Fossil shared Item's icon) - shows up in the card "Element" field and the Element/Type filter.
Cleanup: removed 12 unused icon references (and their source images) that were never actually shown anywhere in the bot.

Improved: the "Download Now" update popup now shows a real progress bar (with the app's own icon/name clearly visible) instead of a bare "Downloading..." with no feedback - previously looked frozen/untrustworthy with nothing confirming it was actually working.

New: a "🔧 Repair Broken Files" button in the Control Panel - force-stops everything, then re-downloads the app and its assets fresh from the latest release and overwrites this folder (your token/settings are kept), then starts it back up. Use this if something stays broken after a normal update, or you're not sure which copy is actually running.

Fixed a real bug: saving Main Path with a brand-new folder (no InjectAccount.ini yet) always failed with Discord's generic "Something went wrong" error, no matter how many times you retried - it was chaining a second modal as the response, which Discord doesn't reliably support. Now saves normally and creates the empty file directly, no chained modal involved.

Fixed a real bug: saving Main Path in /setup could fail with Discord's generic "Something went wrong" error and no real reason shown (found live, a fresh install with an empty folder could trigger this) - now shows the actual error instead of failing silently.

Fixed a real bug affecting every user: the Google Drive HD image fetch could exhaust its request quota when loading a big collage (was making 2 requests per card) - now shares one folder listing per expansion instead of searching per card, cutting requests way down.

Fixed: when Drive HD kept failing, it used to turn off the "Normal Cards HD" toggle for good, needing a manual re-enable in Settings - now pauses itself for a few minutes in memory and retries on its own, no action needed.
Fixed: when Drive HD was off or paused, it also stopped showing cards that were already downloaded in HD - now only blocks new downloads, already-saved cards keep showing HD regardless.
Improved: card collage images (All Cards/Wishlist/Gold Cards) are now noticeably bigger/sharper per card.
Fixed: duplicate custom emojis (same name twice) now get cleaned up automatically, freeing up space so new ones aren't blocked by the 50-per-server limit.

New: All Cards/Wishlist/Gold Cards now have an Element/Type filter (Fire, Water, Supporter, Item, etc.) - as buttons in the browse flow, and as a new `element` option on /card, /wishlist and /goldcards with real autocomplete.
Fixed: a card's "Element" field showed generic "Trainer" for every Supporter/Item/Tool/Stadium card - now shows the real subtype.
Fixed: using `rarity` or `element` on /card without `expansion` silently did nothing - now explains what's missing.
Fixed: using `element` without `rarity` was silently ignored - now works on its own.
Fixed: the `name` autocomplete on /card didn't respect an already-chosen `element` filter, suggesting unrelated cards.
Fixed a real bug: a filter combination with zero matching cards could break the interaction entirely - now shows a clear "no cards match" message instead.
Fixed: Save for Trade's XML forwarding depended on an internal setting no install ever had configured - now respects the real "Send Account XML" checkbox like it's supposed to.
Fixed: two broken icon references (Master Ball, an unused Polvo Estelar one) that could show up as a "couldn't create icons" warning.

New: an "Auto-Close (out of 24h accounts)" toggle in Settings - off by default. When on, an instance that runs out of eligible 24h accounts closes itself (MuMu and its AHK) automatically, with no alert or button click needed.

Fixed a real bug: the "Close Instance" button could turn off MuMu but leave its AHK stuck running forever, since it often runs as Administrator and the bot (deliberately non-admin, for security) couldn't force it closed - now falls back to a narrowly-scoped elevated Scheduled Task as a last resort, confirmed working live.

Fixed: the Control Panel's "Tutorials" button could open a dead "localhost:3005" page (ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED) if the Dashboard had fallen back to a different port due to a conflict - the app now tracks its real port the same way S4T/Heartbeat already did, so the button always opens the right one.

Fixed a real bug: a valuable card could be detected and then silently vanish with zero error if its notification channel's webhook was invalid (e.g. the Discord channel got deleted) - now warns you once via the Updates channel instead of losing it in silence, and a failure on one card no longer risks skipping the rest in the same batch.

Fixed: the expansion logo above a card could fail to show for packs whose short in-game name doesn't exactly match the expansion's full folder name (e.g. "Deluxe" vs "Deluxe Pack ex") - now matches the same partial way card art lookup already did.

New: when heartbeat auto-recovers a frozen instance, its window now gets repositioned back to its correct spot in the grid (detecting automatically whether "Main" is part of the layout or not) - it used to come back full-size/misplaced.

Fixed: the Control Panel's "Start"/"Restart" silently refused to start the engine if port 3000 was already in use by anything (even a totally unrelated app, or a second copy on the same PC) - it now only checks whether THIS copy is already running, and lets the engine's existing auto-fallback (tries the next port, shows the real one to paste in P BOT) do its job like it's designed to.

New: the Control Panel's "Update available" popup has a "Download Manually" button that opens the release page in your real browser - if the in-app download keeps failing on your network (both "Download Now" and the Discord "Update now" button use the same one), this gives a way out that doesn't depend on the app's own network access at all.

Fixed the same "thinking" forever bug across the rest of All Cards/Wishlist/Gold Cards (picking a card, going back, paging, sending to Trading, extracting an account) - a full pass to make sure any unexpected error always shows a message instead of leaving the bot stuck.

Fixed: choosing an expansion in All Cards/Wishlist/Gold Cards could leave the bot "thinking" forever with no error if something went wrong loading that expansion's categories - now shows an actual error message instead.

Fixed: the packaged .exe could report card data files as "not found" even with a correct path - a bug in the previous version's freeze-fix itself, only happening in the packaged version, now corrected.

Fixed: restarting the bot several times in a row while troubleshooting could create duplicate custom emojis and eventually use up the server's emoji slots - now double-checks right before creating each one.
Fixed: if the card data folder was slow to respond (e.g. on a sleeping external/secondary drive), the whole bot could freeze indefinitely - now gives up after 8 seconds instead of hanging forever.
Main Trade: fixed several steps that only worked on English-language accounts, and fixed the final confirmation step not always completing correctly.

Security fix: the localhost-only gate on trade endpoints checked the client-supplied Host header, which can be spoofed - it didn't actually block remote trade requests over the public tunnel or same WiFi like it was supposed to. Now checks the real connection instead.

Fixed: a stale lock file could permanently block the app from starting if Windows ever reused the same process ID for something else - now verifies it's actually Monitor Pokemon before treating it as already running.
Removed the temporary emoji debug message added for troubleshooting - no longer needed.
Cleanup: removed ~9MB of unused leftover images from the install.
Control Panel: the "Start" button no longer stands out in orange - matches Stop/Restart now.

Fixed: on a brand-new server creating many icons for the first time (like right after inviting the bot), a single icon creation could fail transiently and stay missing until the next automatic refresh 10 minutes later - now retries a few times right away with a short pause between attempts.

Temporary: added a one-time diagnostic message to the Updates channel showing the exact emoji IDs the bot has on record for the inventory icon set, to help track down why they stay broken for some installs even after every other known cause was ruled out. Will be removed once explained.

Fixed: the missing-emoji warning was only sent as a DM, which could get silently blocked by Discord privacy settings with no visible error anywhere - now reuses the same reliable Updates channel notification you already get for new versions.

Fixed a real bug affecting existing installs updating in-app: source icon files with accented characters in their filename (Pokélingote, Cupón, Retronómetro, etc.) could silently fail to extract during an in-app update, leaving those specific icons permanently missing - a fresh full download didn't have this problem. Renamed the affected files to plain ASCII, sidestepping the issue entirely.
Fixed: Shinedust could freeze with no warning if a step ran long - the retry watchdog now waits 200s instead of misfiring at 90s, and always DMs you directly if the normal alert can't get through.
Fixed: Shinedust misreading large numbers (e.g. "41,690" read as ",690") - widened the OCR crop for more context, same trick already used for Poké Gold.
Fixed: heartbeat could get stuck in an endless restart loop if you intentionally stopped an instance's AHK/closed it - now leaves manually-stopped instances alone.
Reverted: frozen-instance detection back to 10 minutes (5 was too aggressive with larger friend lists).
New: frozen-instance "auto-recovered" messages now auto-delete after 30s so they don't bury your heartbeat summary.
New: a Reply button on feedback reports lets you DM the reporter directly, no need to share a server with them.
New: the Tutorials page feedback form now supports attaching a screenshot.
New: the bot now DMs you if it can't create a required icon, including the real Discord error, instead of failing silently forever.
New: Shinedust tutorial added to the Tutorials page, plus left/right arrow-key navigation when zoomed into any tutorial image.

Fixed a real security bug: the web trade panel (Info Accounts page) only blocked the "Transfer this card" button from showing outside localhost, but the server endpoints that actually run the trade never checked - anyone with the link (public tunnel or same WiFi) could bypass the button entirely and trigger a real trade, and an unvalidated instance/account field could even inject extra commands. Both closed server-side now.
Fixed: Gold Cards without a golden border yet used to show a generic apology image - now shows the card's real (non-gold) artwork instead, with a "Coming soon in HD and golden borders!" note.

Fixed a real bug: a card reprinted across multiple expansions with the same name and rarity (e.g. Lillie) could show the artwork from the wrong set in S4T trade notifications - now matches against the expansion the pack was actually opened from.

Fixed: the "auto-refreshing" custom emoji cache from v1.5.7 only refreshed when a Discord command was used after its 10-minute window - if you left the bot running with S4T in the background and rarely touched commands, a deleted/recreated emoji could stay broken indefinitely. Now refreshes on a real background timer every 10 minutes, independent of any command usage.
Fixed: a corrupted icon (shown as garbled text) on the Shinedust line of the downloaded Account Report PDF - now uses the real icon like the rest of the fields.
New: All Cards/Wishlist banners and the Gold Cards fallback artwork now come from a shared image repository instead of a local-only folder, so every user gets the same variety, not just Ale.
Fixed: the Control Panel's Tutorials button opened a dead page if the dashboard wasn't running on its default port - now reads the real port.
Updated: Bot General and Build Webhooks tutorials refreshed, and a new Info Accounts tutorial added.

Fixed a real bug affecting every Main Trade attempt: one of the reference images used to detect Main's main menu was broken and never matched anything, so Main Trade could fail at that step no matter how long it waited. Replaced it with a verified one.
Improved: injecting an account now times out in 90 seconds instead of 5 minutes if it genuinely hangs, so a stuck run fails fast with a Retry button instead of a long silent wait.
New: Main Trade now captures a photo of both cards (the one sent and the one received) during the trade, shown on the account's web page once the trade finishes.

Fixed a real bug affecting every user: the "Total Cards" icon never uploaded (Discord rejected it as too large for a custom emoji) - the source image is now resized before uploading, same as every other custom icon.

Fixed: reading Shinedust or a Main Trade could get stuck and time out ("timeout_pantallas_bienvenida") if the game showed a loading error popup before reaching the main menu - now detects it and fails with a clear Retry button instead of hanging (a full restart is more reliable than trying to recover mid-run).
New: a warning now shows when starting Main Trade on a PC with less than 8GB of RAM, recommending Friend Trade instead (it only needs 1 instance running, much lighter).

Improved: the Poké Gold reading now double-checks itself (reads twice a second apart and compares) instead of trusting a single capture - helps on slower PCs where the screen might not be fully done rendering yet.

Fixed: reading Shinedust or injecting an account could get stuck and time out ("timeout_pantallas_bienvenida") if the game showed an "Update the App"/"a new version is available" popup before reaching the main menu - now detects and dismisses these too, same as the other welcome-screen popups.
Fixed: the downloaded Account Report PDF showed a broken internal name ("Pokelingote_TCGP") instead of "Poké Gold (non-paid)"/"(paid)" for that field.

Fixed a real bug affecting anyone running MuMu instances at a different resolution than Ale's own (e.g. smaller instances to fit more on screen): the Shinedust/inventory reading used fixed pixel coordinates calibrated only to Ale's resolution, so on a different resolution the crop for one field could bleed into the row below it (reported: "Poké Gold (non-paid)" read as "0104" instead of "4"). Now scales every crop proportionally to the actual screenshot size instead of assuming a fixed resolution.

Temporary: Shinedust screenshots are kept in the automation\Logs folder instead of being auto-deleted after each run, to help diagnose any remaining reading issues on other resolutions - will be reverted to auto-delete once confirmed working everywhere.

Fixed a real bug affecting every user except Ale: the inventory icons (Poké Gold, Shinedust, tickets, hourglasses) on Info Accounts/Shinedust results used emoji IDs hardcoded to Ale's own bot application - since every user runs their own separate bot application, these always showed as broken plain text (":Pokelingote_TCGP:") for everyone else. Now uploads/resolves these icons per-server automatically, same as the rarity/type icons already did.

Fixed a real bug affecting every existing install updating in-app (not a fresh download): the automation folder (the AHK scripts behind account injection, Trade, Main Trade and Shinedust) was never included in the auto-update package, only in a brand new zip download - anyone who updated through the Panel or Discord instead of downloading fresh kept hitting "faltan_archivos" / "scripts not found" no matter what. Now included in every update.

Fixed a real bug affecting most installs: injecting an account (Info Accounts, Trade, Shinedust, any card lookup) failed with "faltan_archivos" unless AutoHotkey was installed at the exact same version/folder as Ale's own PC - now finds any AutoHotkey version installed in the standard locations.

Improved: the account cards page (Info Accounts) got a full visual refresh - light blue theme matching the Tutorials page, a live stats bar, and a green progress ring around each expansion's logo showing how close it is to completion.
New: selecting a specific expansion on the account cards page now shows its own X/Y and % card in the top bar (separate from the account-wide total), with a mini progress ring next to it.

Fixed: opening MonitorPokemon.exe directly (by accident, instead of through the Control Panel) showed a confusing console window in the taskbar and could loop reopening the setup page - it now always runs fully hidden in the background, same as when started from the Panel.
Removed: MonitorPokemon.exe (the engine) no longer shows up in the folder at all - only the Control Panel is meant to be opened directly.

Improved: Control Panel reorganized into 4 clear sections (Control, S4T/Heartbeat, Discord, and a new one with working Tutorials and Support buttons) - removed the 3 small unlabeled icons at the bottom, one of which was a leftover broken placeholder link.
Security: removed PDF tutorials entirely after one showed up with a leaked screenshot - the bot now also auto-deletes any old tutorial PDFs still sitting in your install folder on startup.
New: Tutorials channels now open a proper in-app page instead of a PDF, works from your phone or PC - step-by-step images, click one to zoom in, light/dark mode, and a Donate button.
New: Trade button on Gold Cards results and the Friend Trade button are now disabled (known issues being worked on).
New: Gold Cards shows an apology message instead of the un-golded image when a card's gold border isn't uploaded yet.
New: All Cards/Wishlist banners now pick a random wallpaper from the shared image repository each time.
Improved: HD image fetch failures now log the real reason (Drive permission issue vs. missing file) to a simple drive_hd_errores.txt file for easier troubleshooting.
Fixed: the update process could get stuck in an infinite loop with a visible black console window if the old .exe was locked (e.g. by antivirus) - now caps retries and stays hidden like it should.
New: a "🔴 Kill Everything" button in the Control Panel to force-stop everything, including a stuck update window, without needing Task Manager.
Improved: HD image fetch failures now log the real reason (Drive permission issue vs. missing file) instead of one generic message.
Fixed: Main Trade/Shinedust crashes caused by the bot re-opening the game on top of an already-open instance.
Fixed: the Trade button on a Shinedust result could fail with "didn't respond in time" - now reuses the same reliable flow as the normal Trade button.
Fixed: error messages could silently fail to show up if a Main Trade step took longer than Discord's 15-minute interaction window.
Improved: Shinedust results now show account file + all inventory fields in a clean vertical layout, with custom icons instead of generic emoji.
New: a Tutorials channel with a PDF guide for every command.
New: Gold Cards shows an apology message instead of the un-golded image when a card's gold border isn't uploaded yet.
Disabled: Friend Trade button, and Trade button on Gold Cards results (known issues being worked on).
New: HD image fetch failures now log to a simple drive_hd_errores.txt file for easier troubleshooting.
Fixed: Build Embed preview text was slightly out of sync with the real wishlist/rarity/general messages.

New: the 👛 Shinedust button now also reads Poké Gold, Shop/Special Shop/Premium Tickets, and Pack/Wonder/Trade Hourglasses and Rewind Watch from the same account, shown alongside Shinedust - not just the Shinedust number anymore.
New: a 📋 Info Accounts button on Shinedust results sends the PDF/dashboard with all that live data included, instantly (it was already read during that same run, no need to inject again).

New: Info Accounts (from All Cards/Wishlist) now asks if you also want live in-game data before generating the PDF - say yes and it injects the account to read it, say no and it works like before (instant, no injection).

Fixed: reading Shinedust could get stuck or fail right after injecting an account, if the game showed a welcome-back carousel, a "Tap to Start" title screen, or a "News" update popup before reaching the main menu - now detects and dismisses all of these automatically.

New: a 🔄 Retry button now appears whenever a Shinedust step fails (instance won't turn on, injection failed, stuck on a screen, couldn't read the number) - retries the whole flow without having to re-select the account.
New: if the Shinedust flow gets stuck with no progress for 90 seconds (game crashed, frozen instance), it now retries automatically up to 3 times before asking you to retry manually.
Fixed: the auto-downloaded remote-access link could fail once right after updating (Windows briefly locks the fresh file) - now retries and no longer races with the previous instance closing.
Fixed: the Info Accounts remote-access link still didn't show up after "Update Now" - now downloads what it needs on its own.
Fixed: the Info Accounts remote-access link now works for everyone, not just this PC.

Fixed: some installs could end up reporting "you're on the latest version" without actually having that version's code, if an update attempt failed partway through - this forces every install to genuinely re-check and re-download, closing that gap.

New: Info Accounts web dashboard - full card gallery for an account (grouped by expansion, rarity filter, click to zoom, quantity badges), reachable from Discord and shareable via a Download PDF button.
New: Info Accounts button added directly on card lookups (not just Extract XML) - pick the account and it posts the XML, JSON, total card count and dashboard links to your Info Accounts channel.
Fixed: Alolan/Galarian/Hisuian/Paldean cards showed "Element: Unknown" - their names come glued together with no space in the game's data, so the lookup never matched.
Fixed: /card, /wishlist and /goldcards ignored the expansion/rarity filters unless you also picked a card name - now they jump straight to the right list.
Fixed: the channel panel (All Cards/Wishlist/Gold Cards) was moving itself to the bottom just from opening a card's XML view - now it only moves when you run the command yourself.
Added: a Quantity badge (overlaid on the image) on single-card lookups, matching the collage style.
Removed the control panel's auto-launch shortcut at Windows startup.
Fixed: God Pack detection was flagging every normal pack, not just real god packs.
Added: quantity badge back on card collages, expansion logo now above the collage.
Added: quantity badge on S4T/God Pack alert collages too.
Disabled: Trade and Shinedust buttons temporarily (known bugs being fixed).

Fixed: cards from a brand-new expansion showed no image anywhere (collage, card lookup, S4T alerts) until someone downloaded them locally by hand or Kevin uploaded them to Drive - now falls back automatically to Ale's own card image repository, caching it locally the first time so it works from day one of a new set's release.

New: Wishlist, All Cards and Gold Cards now show a collage with the real image of every card on the page (after picking expansion + rarity), instead of just a text list - easier to recognize cards at a glance.

Removed the manual instance-picker ("⚙️ Settings Trade" inside the Trading channel) - it let anyone open any instance and send friend requests by hand, bypassing the automatic 🔄 Trade flow. That automatic flow is the only supported way to trade now.
Removed "Cards Wishlist"/"All Cards"/"Gold Cards"/"Extract XML"/"Auto Trade" buttons from the /setup panel - redundant now that each has its own channel with direct access.
Removed "Reset Total"/"Delete Channels" from the /setup panel entirely - too risky to have sitting there, even for the server owner. Ask Ale if you ever genuinely need to wipe everything.
New: a 🗑️ Remove Friend option under 📊 Status ID lets you delete a saved friend from the list - before you could only add, never remove.

New: a 🖼️ "Normal Cards HD" On/Off toggle in /setup - off by default. Gold cards always download in HD (no other source exists for them), but normal cards only download HD images if you turn this on, since it can add up several GB on disk over time.

Fixed: the leftover "Monitor Pokemon" shortcut (removed in 1.5.19, redundant with MonitorPokemonPanel.exe) now also gets cleaned up automatically for anyone who already had it from an older version - no need to redownload the whole zip or migrate to a new folder, updating normally removes it.

Fixed a real bug: "Check for Updates" crashed with an error specifically whenever there WAS a real update available (never when already up to date) - the "What's new" list was built from every single release note ever recorded (this changelog keeps growing, never gets trimmed), which by now is way past Discord's 4096-character limit for an embed description. Now only shows as many recent notes as fit, with a note that older history is on GitHub.

Fixed the real cause of "Check for Updates" failing again right after the previous fix, now with "Expected values to be equals"/"Invalid string length" instead: the experimental --use-system-ca Node flag (added for one antivirus-related case) has real bugs validating GitHub's certificate on some Windows setups. Removed it - it was breaking more than it fixed.

Fixed the real cause of "Check for Updates" still failing with "Received one or more errors" even after forcing IPv4 first: Node was still racing an IPv6 connection in parallel in the background ("Happy Eyeballs") and grouping both failures into the same generic error if the second attempt also failed. Now disables that race entirely, so it either works or shows the real underlying error instead of a generic one.

Fixed a real bug: opening the Control Panel could silently launch the bot engine on its own even with no token configured yet, which then opened the token/API setup page in your browser without you pressing anything - and it kept reopening every time you closed it. The panel now only auto-starts the engine on open if a token is already saved; otherwise it just shows "Not configured" like it should.

Removed a leftover "Monitor Pokemon" shortcut that got created in the main folder right after saving your token for the first time - it was a duplicate of MonitorPokemonPanel.exe from before that had its own real icon, and only confused things by having two things that opened the same panel.

Reverted the Control Panel window title back to just "Monitor Pokemon" (undoing the "— Control Panel" suffix added a few versions ago) - going back to the exact 1.5.13 state per request. Nothing else changed: no code was touched between 1.5.13 and this version, so this update won't affect the token-setup window behavior.

Reverted the MonitorPokemon.exe → MonitorPokemonBot.exe rename from the last couple of versions - it fixed a minor confusion (which .exe to open) but caused a much worse one: renaming reset Windows SmartScreen's reputation for the file, so "Windows protected your PC" started showing up for everyone on this update, when it hadn't for a long time. Not worth the trade - keeping the old, already-trusted name.
The Control Panel window title now says "Monitor Pokemon — Control Panel" instead of just "Monitor Pokemon", so it's clear this is the window you're supposed to open and use.
New: manually pressing "Check for Updates" now also posts the update announcement (with an @mention) to your Updates channel, not just as a private reply to whoever clicked it.
New: manually pressing "Check for Updates" now also posts the update announcement (with an @mention) to your Updates channel, not just as a private reply to whoever clicked it.
New: after pressing "Update now" and the download finishes, you get a message in your Updates channel reminding you to press Sync Channels and re-save your Main Path once it restarts.

Fixed the real cause of "Check for Updates" failing with "Received one or more errors" (confirmed on a clean Windows 10, no antivirus involved): Node was racing an IPv6 and IPv4 connection at the same time ("Happy Eyeballs"), and failed entirely on PCs where IPv6 has no real route even though DNS still returns an IPv6 record. Now forces IPv4 first, avoiding the race.

Fixed: "Check for Updates" (and the automatic background check) could fail permanently on some networks/ISPs that block raw.githubusercontent.com - now falls back to api.github.com automatically if the first attempt fails.
New: the update notification posted in your Updates channel now @mentions you directly instead of sitting there as a silent embed nobody notices.

Fixed: reading Shinedust could silently show the wrong failure reason (just an exit code) instead of the real one (e.g. "ocr invalido", "puerto no encontrado") - the actual error is now shown so it can be diagnosed.

Fixed: the Shinedust reader depended on a hardcoded path that only existed on Ale's own PC, and could also break entirely if Kevin's own toolkit changed - it's now fully independent and no longer depends on anyone else's files.

New: Main Trade now runs fully automatically end-to-end - injects the donor account, sends the friend request, offers a card from Main's own Favorites, the donor responds with the requested card, Main finalizes and cleans up the friendship, and both instances shut down on their own. No manual clicks needed anywhere in the middle.
New: a 📄 Extract XML button on card lookups (/card, /wishlist, Gold Cards) sends an account's XML + JSON straight to your Extract XML channel, narrowed to accounts that actually have that card.
Fixed: the 👛 Shinedust button on card lookups was listing every saved account instead of just the ones that actually have the card - could show over a thousand unrelated accounts to pick from.
Fixed: sending a friend request could silently fail and time out if the tap on "Send Request" didn't register the first time - it now keeps retrying while the button is still on screen.
Fixed: the Shinedust reader could capture the screenshot too fast after opening the inventory and misread the number before it finished loading.
New: 🆔 Add Friend and 📊 Status ID buttons added directly to /setup, so you can manage saved friend IDs without opening a specific instance first.
⚡ Aggressive Trade is now marked "Coming Soon" and disabled - it isn't implemented yet, this avoids confusion until it ships in a future release.

New: a dedicated "Shinedust" channel now receives the result of the 👛 Shinedust button, with 🔄 Trade and 📄 Extract XML buttons on it that jump straight into those flows using the same account - no need to search or select it again.
New: a 🔄 Trade button on card lookups lets you pick an account that has that card and an instance, injects it, and drops you in your Run MumuPlayer channel ready to trade.

Fixed: the MuMu panel (Add Friend/Submit/Status, and the new Trade/Shinedust buttons) only worked on Ale's own PC - two hardcoded paths never used each user's own configured "Main Path", so anyone else got "Could not save the selection to InjectAccount.ini". Existing users need to re-save Main Path once (same folder, in /setup) to pick up the fix.

Fixed: "Create Bots" and "Inject Rewards" modes don't work off a 24h account pool like Inject/Wonderpick do - they were triggering false "instance stalled, close it?" alerts during normal multi-minute pauses between cycles.

New: a "Shinedust" button on card lookups (/card, /wishlist) lets you pick any account and instance, injects it, and reads the account's current Shinedust balance automatically (via on-screen OCR, no manual navigation), posting the result back on the same card.
"Check for Updates" now shows the actual underlying error (network code, HTTP status, etc.) instead of just a generic message, so a repeated failure can actually be diagnosed from a screenshot.

Node now also trusts Windows' own certificate store in addition to its built-in list - if an antivirus that inspects HTTPS traffic was silently breaking "Check for Updates" (a real case seen this week), this should fix it without needing to update through the app instead.

Fixed: custom emojis (rarity/type icons) could break permanently and show as plain ":name:" text instead of the icon if they were ever deleted/recreated on the server - the bot cached emoji IDs forever without checking they still existed. Now refreshes every 10 minutes and re-uploads anything missing automatically.

Fixed: Trainer cards showed no photo when the game reported 2+ copies on the same line (e.g. "Cynthia (x2)") - the "(x2)" was being used as part of the search name and never matched, so the image lookup always failed for those.
"Check for Updates" in /setup now logs the real error when it fails instead of only showing a generic message, so a failure can actually be diagnosed instead of being a total black box.

Fixed: with more than 25 configured webhooks, the "Select a webhook to edit" dropdown in /webhook silently cut off the extras (a Discord platform limit of 25 options per dropdown) - now adds a second dropdown so every webhook is reachable, no matter how many there are.

Fixed: MuMuManager.exe was only ever looked for on drive C: - if MuMuPlayer was installed on a different drive (the installer lets you pick one), every MumuPlayer-related button failed with "MuMuManager.exe not found" even though it was installed correctly. Now checks drives C: through J:.

Every channel's webhook now gets a proper name and profile picture instead of the generic "Bot {type}" placeholder (Cards, Wishlist, God Pack, rarities, Settings, Heartbeat, Donate, Updates, Feedback, etc.) - purely cosmetic, doesn't affect anyone who already customized their own webhook with /webhook.

Added the real tutorial for Settings (token/API key setup, with a reminder to keep your token private) - also placed loose in the main folder as "TUTORIAL MONITOR POKEMON.pdf" so it's visible right after extracting, without opening Discord first.

Fixed: the panel's "Download Now" always showed "Invalid JSON primitive" even when the update downloaded correctly, because a database connection log was mixing into the same output the panel expects to be pure JSON - it now goes to the right place and the popup shows the real result.
Fixed: "Quit Monitor Pokemon" didn't close the control panel itself, only the bot - that could leave the panel's own file locked and cause "access denied" when replacing it during a manual update.
The control panel itself now updates automatically too (before, only the bot did - the panel had to be replaced by hand on every release).
Renamed the /webhook option "type" to "channel" for clarity.

Fixed: the account XML was forwarded to Discord even when "Send Account XML" was left unchecked in the emulator-reading tool, as long as a fallback account folder was configured - now it only forwards the XML when it actually arrives attached (i.e. that checkbox is on).

If the panel's "Download Now" fails, the error now shows the actual process output instead of just a generic parser error, so a failure can be diagnosed from a screenshot without needing remote access to that PC.
Fixed: clicking the S4T/Heartbeat fields to copy them could show a Windows clipboard error and crash the panel (found by a real user testing it) - it now retries automatically instead of failing.

New: a real control panel window (Start/Stop/Restart, live Token/API status, one-click copy for the S4T/Heartbeat addresses, Discord bot/server/user info, and a Donate/Tutorials shortcut) replaces juggling separate .bat files.
The panel now warns you right there when a new version is out, with a button to download it directly or jump to the Updates channel.
Advanced/rarely-needed files (Start, Reconfigure, Quit, Unblock) moved into an "Advanced" folder to keep the main folder clean — the control panel covers all of that day-to-day.

Fixed a real bug: the Heartbeat/S4T status shown in /setup only worked correctly if PM2 was installed — for everyone using the plain .exe, it always showed offline even when everything was running fine.
/card and /wishlist now have a rarity filter (1-4 Diamond, Star, Trainer, Full Art, Rainbow, Immersive, Shiny, Crown Rare) between expansion and name.
Renamed a few command options that were still in Spanish (name/type/image) to English.
Added a "Check for Updates" button to /setup, so you can check right away instead of waiting for the automatic check.
Fixed: after installing an update, the program reopened in a visible console window instead of staying hidden in the background like normal.

Fixed: the auto-start shortcut could get stuck behind a Windows security prompt on every boot, since the launcher files were still marked as "downloaded from the internet". They now unblock themselves automatically the first time you run them.
The bot now also checks for updates periodically while running (not just on startup), so it notices new versions even if you never restart it — without repeating the same notification.
Fixed a critical bug: using /feedback crashed the entire bot (not just that command) because of a text field label that was too long for Discord's limit.
Fixed: if you opened the program before inviting the bot to your server, it could automatically leave that server the next time it restarted, thinking it wasn't authorized.
Fixed: slash commands weren't showing up if the bot joined a server after the program was already running — now they register right away when it joins.
Channels with a real command (Cards, Wishlist, Extract XLM, Auto Trade, Settings) now show the actual working panel as soon as they're created, instead of a generic description.
The setup wizard now shows the S4T and Heartbeat addresses to use in your reroll tool right on the "Saved" screen.
Feedback now supports a title, an optional screenshot, and shows your Discord profile.
Fixed: channel panels sometimes appeared duplicated when editing them.
Panels now move to the bottom of the channel automatically after 5 minutes of use, and always move there when you run the command by hand.
Fixed: "Sync Channels" now detects and repairs webhooks that stopped working, without needing to delete the channel.
Fixed: the MuMu "Turn On" button now waits for the instance to actually finish starting before reporting its status.
The trade/injection automation is now protected against stuck confirmation windows, and no longer freezes waiting for a click that never comes.
